primary_text:
There’s a reason you keep certain words close.
Proverbs 3:5–6 is for the moments when your mind gets ahead of you—when you’re second-guessing, looking for answers, or trying to control what happens next.
“Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.”
The Prayer I Share puts that verse on your wrist, so you can carry the reminder into whatever the day brings.
headline: Scripture Bracelets to Wear and Share

hook.spoken: I started wearing this bracelet because I would think a lot.
hook.visual: low POV of a wrist with a red cord bracelet on a sidewalk, man walks toward camera

angle: a small worn object keeps one calming reminder close through an overthinking day
structure: POV overthinking callout -> confession -> verse reminder -> trust-one-step resolution -> bracelet close-ups -> Shop Now
why_it_won: Hypothesis: POV callout names a universal recurring mental pain in 1s; native walking UGC with word-by-word captions; a multi-version ad that the brand is iterating (only 19 days old, so longevity proof is weak)
